_note: Model registry: every callable model + its economics. ADDING A MODEL IS ONE ENTRY here (id must be fully qualified provider/id). Prices are USD per 1M tokens and are USER-MAINTAINED ESTIMATES — the eval harness computes real per-task cost as tokens*price, so keep these current. local=true means unmetered (Ollama/DMR). available=false hides a model from routing without deleting it. Override this file at ~/.pi-stack/routing/models.json.
